programme.title: Веселая школа здоровья. Гендерное воспитание дошкольников
programme.desc: Многие люди живут по принципу: «Все лучшее детям». Что же нужно ребенку для счастья? Может быть это новый айфон, необычное лего, кукольный домик, популярные игрушки? Вовсе нет. Главное для ребенка – внимание родителей. Счастье для ребенка – это мама и папа. Семья – главный фактор в гендерном воспитании детей, где папа является образцом мужского поведения, а мама – женского поведения. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Татьяна Малышева, Гость: Самуил Баринов, Настя Жукова

programme.title: Библия. Лютер и Библия
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». Протестантская Реформация в 2017 году отметила свой 500-летний юбилей. Мартин Лютер, с именем которого неразрывно связано это историческое событие, перевел Библию на немецкий язык и дал право толковать Священное Писание каждому человеку. Какие принципы Реформации провозгласил Лютер? Кто в истории России первым перевел Библию на родной язык и тем самым внес большой вклад в духовное развитие страны? Ведущий: Иван Лобанов, ведущий научный сотрудник Института перевода Библии им. М. П.Кулакова, Гость: А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Ю. Друми, доктор богословия, Н. Шабуров, профессор, директор Центра Изучения Религий РГГУ, о. игумен Иннокентий (Павлов), кандидат богословия, член правления РБО, С. Ряховский, Начальствующий Епископ Российского объединенного союза христиан веры евангельской, член Совета по взаимодействию с религиозными объединениями при Президенте РФ, Н. Гузов

programme.title: Живая проповедь. Вечеря в адвентистской традиции
programme.desc: Вечеря Господня в современной церкви – это участие в принятии символов тела и крови Христа, чтобы стать частью Христа, частью церкви, в которой присутствует Бог. Так понимают этот обряд в адвентистской церкви. Кто может принимать участие в вечери и надо ли к ней как-то готовиться? Ведущий: Александр Синицын, священнослужитель

programme.title: Мастерская добрых дел. Конкурс на звание лучшего дворника (Иоанн Креститель) / Божий спецагент
programme.desc: У Бога когда-то был особый человек, которому Он поручил специальную и непростую миссию – подготовить Израильский народ к приходу Мессии. Его звали Иоанн, и его рождение, так же, как и рождение Иисуса Христа, было необычным: о нем возвестил будущим родителям Божий посланник Гавриил. Иоанн как Божий спецагент хорошо справился с поручением Господа, но только потому, что удалялся от зла и пороков мира. Бог может дать поручение любому человеку, поэтому мы тоже всегда должны оставаться чистыми сердцем и верными Господу. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Гость: Влад Лапшин, Аня Малышева

programme.title: Территория реальности. Верующий или религиозный?
programme.desc: «У меня Бог в душе» – говорят некоторые люди. Что значит – быть верующим, но не религиозным? И плохо ли это? О какой вере говорил людям Христос? Как должна проявляться истинная вера? Ведущий: Вадим Трусюк, Гость: Андрей Качалаба, священнослужитель, доктор практического богословия, блогер

programme.title: Загадки древних рукописей. Как общаться с мертвецами?
programme.desc: Испокон веков люди хотели не терять связи с умершими родственниками. И искали способы общения с ними, ожидали от них защиты. Возможно ли общение с умершими? Что о таком общении говорит Библия? Как умершие библейские авторы могут общаться с нами – без мистики и опасных последствий? Ведущий: Олег Габрусевич, священнослужитель, историк, богослов, Гость: Александр Богданенков, священнослужитель, филолог, литературовед

programme.title: Контрасты души. Место общения с Богом или клуб по интересам?
programme.desc: Вопрос посещения церкви для многих спорный. Как, как часто, где, когда и нужно ли вообще посещать богослужение вы узнаете из этой программы. Божьих вам благословений в данном вопросе. Ведущий: Андрей Юнак, Гость: Сергей Николаевич Пацукевич, магистр богословия, священнослужитель

programme.desc: В гостях у ТРК «Три Ангела» Нелли Пашинян, педагог от Бога с 30-летним стажем. Когда человек узнает о своем призвании в жизни? Какова роль педагогов, учителей в формировании и становлении личности человека? Могут ли они помочь или помешать молодому человеку найти путь к себе? Ведущий: Мария Мараханова, Гость: Нелли Пашинян, педагог, автор проекта «Семицветная педагогика»

programme.title: Реальный Бог. Как Бог дал мне подсказку
programme.desc: У Виктории был хороший материальный доход и она решила купить квартиру дочери в новом доме. Но почему -то ей было неспокойно и она ощущала тревогу. Прислушавшись к голосу Божьему внутри себя, она отказалась от покупки. От каких проблем оградил ее Бог впоследствии? Ведущий: Виктория Вихарева

programme.title: Возрождение. Осия и Гомерь: предательство и прощение
programme.desc: Как действует Божья спасительная благодать? Однажды Бог велел пророку Осии взять в жены блудную, порочную женщину. Почему? Что Бог хотел показать своему народу в этой истории? Неужели Бог прощает измену, неверность? К чему Бог призывает человека? Ведущий: Андрей Довгель, священнослужитель

programme.title: Происхождение мира. Бог и Большой взрыв
Мужчину и женщину сотворил их. Конфликты в семье: предвидеть заранее, решать вовремя
programme.desc: Конфликты в семье – явление повсеместное. Конфликты возникают везде, где есть люди, потому что происходит столкновение разных интересов, точек зрения и целей. Из-за чего возникают конфликты в семьях, ведь семьи создают люди, более-менее подходящие друг другу? Как Библия учит выходить из конфликтных ситуаций? Ведущий: Анна Богатская, Гость: Виталий Киссер, священнослужитель, семейный консультант

programme.title: СТОП насилие. Как не нужно справляться с психологической травмой?
programme.desc: Боль после психологической травмы сильна, её крайне трудно терпеть, поэтому человек часто ищет любые способы избавиться от неё. Но любые не значит действенные. Есть способы, которые точно не помогут избавиться от психотравмы. Ведущий: Александр Сахаров, священнослужитель, консультант по семейным взаимоотношениям

programme.title: Принято считать. Как помочь ребенку, если в классе буллинг
programme.desc: Если ваш ребенок стал жертвой травли, ваша поддержка решает все. Как понять, что это буллинг, а не просто конфликт? Какие шаги предпринять: от эмоциональной поддержки ребенка до грамотного диалога со школой? И как помочь ему восстановить самооценку и вернуть чувство безопасности? Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Мария Вачева, психолог

programme.title: Библия в деталях с Андреем Качалабой. Какой день святой? (вторая часть)
programme.desc: Соблюдение субботы для многих христиан представляется необходимым для спасения атрибутом их веры. Но до сих пор многие задают вопросы, как правильно её соблюдать, какой промежуток времени считается субботой, почему в субботу можно делать одно и нельзя другое. Ведущий: Андрей Качалаба, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Люди идут к Богу разными путями, некоторые отражают этот путь в своём творчестве. Так произошло и у Анны Богатской, автора и исполнителя христианских песен. Ведущий: Вилина Парфенова, Гость: Анна Богатская, автор и исполнитель христианских песен

programme.title: Лица времени. По примеру Отца… (первая серия)
programme.desc: Есть люди, которые при жизни горят, как звезды, а когда они уходят, то оставляют теплый след в сердцах людей, с которыми они соприкасались. Таким человеком был Дмитрий Онисимович Юнак, который строил свою жизнь на библейском основании. В первой серии двухсерийного фильма «По примеру Отца» можно познакомиться с богоискательством родителей Д.О. Юнака, с преодолением трудностей в соблюдении библейской заповеди о субботе в жизни героя фильма, с историей написания книги «Миф или действительность», а также с историей собирания материалов о Церкви христиан адвентистов седьмого дня. Ведущий: Ирина Кириченко, Гость: Д. Юнак, пастор, историк церкви, В. Юнак пастор, А. Юнак, пастор, П. Гончар, пастор, Н. Подчуфарова, учитель музыки, В. Костев, пастор, А. Гладков, пастор

programme.title: Библия 21-го века. Бытие, 13 глава. Авраам и Лот делят территорию
programme.desc: В жизни Авраама наступил момент, когда его дому и дому его племянника Лота пришлось разделиться из-за тесноты. Перед ними лежала земля, и Авраам как старший имел право первым выбрать для себя место своего будущего обитания. Но он предоставил это право Лоту. Почему? Из-за того что боялся конфликтов или по другой причине? Ведущий: Ольга Феофанова, Гость: Дмитрий Булатов, священнослужитель, доктор практической теологии

programme.title: Контрасты души. Победить свой страх
programme.desc: Почему человек испытывает страх? Страх сковывает, мучает, отравляет жизнь. Мы боимся заболеть, потерять близких, боимся смерти, переживаем за будущее наших детей. Можно ли перестать бояться? Помогает ли вера в Бога в этом? Что такое страх Божий? Ведущий: Алексей Бритов, Гость: Виталий Бахтин, священнослужитель

programme.title: Инструментальная музыка. Элегия (Инструментальная)
programme.desc: Ведущий: Оксана Трусюк

programme.title: По душам. Полное доверие Богу реально?
programme.desc: Доверие Богу – важная составляющая веры. Но можно ли и нужно ли доверять Ему во всём, всегда и везде? Как можно доверять Богу на практике? Что делать, если доверия нет или оно недостаточное? Ведущий: Настя Сергеева, Гость: Маша Мараханова, Оля Феофанова, Вика Булатова, Таня Булатова

programme.title: Просто о сложном. Что выбрать для чтения?
programme.desc: Сегодня все больше и больше людей читают книги. Чтение вновь становится модным. Как выбрать хорошую книгу? Есть мировой бестселлер – Библия. Многие писатели, философы, ученые черпали в ней вдохновение. Библия – откровение Бога, своеобразный портрет Иисуса Христа. Ведущий: Антон Бойков, священнослужитель

programme.title: Найди свой путь. Как доверять Богу?
programme.desc: Доверие Богу формируется постепенно. Если просить Бога дать уверенность в том, что Он всемогущий, и если довериться Ему, то это доверие будет оправдано. Если Бог дал возможность – Он не оставит. История Насти это доказывает. Ведущий: Сергей Парфенов, Размик Меликбекян, Гость: Анастасия Иванова

programme.title: Христианские песни. Верую
programme.desc: Ведущий: Вилина Парфенова, Гость: Сергей Парфенов (синтезатор), Богдан Павлюк (гитара)

programme.title: Загадки древних рукописей. В поисках шалома
programme.desc: Наша жизнь лишена мира. Разлад в семьях, проблемы на работе, сложные и тяжелые диагнозы – это и многое другое вызывает смятение в сердцах. В Библии есть понятие «шалом». Какой смысл несет это слово, и как оно помогает найти мир и покой? Почему и в каком случае выполнение правильного религиозного обряда не может принести покоя? Ведущий: Олег Габрусевич, священнослужитель, историк, богослов, Гость: Александр Богданенков, священнослужитель, филолог, литературовед

programme.title: Где сейчас Бог? Грех неведения. Как нам ценить дар жертвы Иисуса Христа?
programme.desc: Существуют грехи, о которых человек знает, и грехи, о которых он не знает, что это грехи. Грехи неведения: будет ли за них наказание и будет ли оно справедливым? Как искупил Иисус Христос грехи неведения? Ведущий: Юлия Уткина, Гость: Александр Камнев, пресвитер церкви и Елена Варнавская

programme.title: Музыкальные клипы. Беглец
programme.desc: Ведущий: Анжелика Вишня

programme.title: Глубина Евангелия. Универсальность Евангелия
programme.desc: Правда ли,что Христос умер за всех или есть те, кто не сможет иметь жизнь вечную? Сам человек решить проблему греха не мог. Адам даже не мог искренне раскаяться в отступлении от Бога, когда Бог встретил его в Эдемском саду. Бог полностью взял на себя ответственность за случившееся. Это произошло не по просьбе человека, а по замыслу Бога. Бог дал возможность каждому человеку способность враждовать с сатаной и способность верить в Бога и принимать Евангелии. Евангелие, спасение универсально, дано каждому. Ведущий: Алексей Бритов, Гость: Виталий Олийник, руководитель Центра духовного просвещения

programme.title: ВкусСнятоВо. Быстрые булочки
programme.desc: Булочки с начинкой – одно из любимых детских блюд. Эти булочки-улитки готовятся быстро. Быстро и правильно можно делать любое дело: и уроки выучить, и в кружок сходить, и книгу прочитать. Еще и погулять с друзьями время останется. В чем секрет? Как все успевать? Ведущий: Алексей Ронжин, Мирослава Никогосян Алена Ронжина

programme.title: Зарядка +. Комплекс физических упражнений «Время»
programme.desc: Комплекс гимнастики для детей 6-10 лет, способствующий общему укреплению мышц, дающий детям заряд бодрости, в ходе которого дети, выполняя упражнения, в стихотворной форме вспомнят основные отрезки времени: секунда, минута, час, сутки, неделя, месяц, год. Ведущий: Арина Макарова, тренер школы олимпийского резерва по Эстетической гимнастике, Гость: Антонина Вилкова, Алиса Тартыжова, Арина Даньчишина

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. programme.desc: In einer Koproduktion der lokalen TV-Sender in Thüringen bringt Moderator Mike Langer Politik ganz nah an die Menschen. programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts a new quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the Pretenders, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Ross and Barry or Mairi and John, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Ross & Barry no Mairi & John, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Garradh Phadruig
programme.desc: Summer is over, but Peter is already preparing for the next growing season. Tha’n samhradh seachad ach tha Pàdruig a’deasachadh airson ràithe fàs na h-ath-bhliadhna.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Mhoireasdan, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. Actress-turned-interior designer, Erica Morrison, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers, she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Tuath Cheòl le Ruairidh Gray
programme.desc: An seinneadair Ruairidh Gray a’ tadhal air an Grand Ole Opry ann an Glaschu agus a’ toirt sùil bhlàth air ais air sreathan Tuath Cheòl. Bidh Ruairidh a’ taghadh cuid de na taisbeanaidhean a bha anns na prògraman agus a bha a’ còrdadh gu mòr ri luchd-leantainn ceòl dùthchasach aig an àm. Am measg na bhios anns a’ phrògram seo, Na h-Òganaich, Anna Latharna NicIllÌosa, Murdigan Dòmhnallach, Màiri NicAonghais, Tormod MacIllEathain nach maireann, Iain Costello & Iain Moireach agus Fiona Cheanadach. Singer Ruairidh Gray visits Glasgow’s Grand Ole Opry for a nostalgic look back at the legendary music series Tuath Cheòl and presents musical selections from the original programmes. Hugely popular with country music fans at the time, this episode features musicians and singers including Na h-Òganaich, Anne Lorne Gillies, Murdigan MacDonald, Mairi MacInnes, Ian Costello & John Murray and Fiona Kennedy. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: An caladh na theine san t-seachdain mu dheireadh de sheusan a’ ghiomaich. Gun an còrr aige ri chall, tha Adam a’ cur a cheann an geall air an tùna. A fire rips through the harbour in the final week of lobster season. With little left to lose, Adam bets it all on tuna. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le taisbeanadh air leth bho Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House aig Belladrum 2025 is an còmhlan cliùiteach Albannach, Texas, a’ tilleadh chun na fèise mar phrìomh chòmhlan oidhche Shathairne. Le fuaim leantaileach is guth iongantach Sharleen Spiteri, tha an còmhlan a’ toirt thugainn na h-òrain as fheàrr aca, ’s chan eil leisg air an t-sluagh seinn còmhla riutha. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain MacDonald present from the Hot House Stage at Belladrum as iconic Scottish band Texas return to the festival to headline Saturday night. With their timeless sound and Sharleen Spiteri’s unmistakable vocals, the group perform classic hits, and the crowd need no encouragement to join in.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: The team are in Alloa, Scotland’s smallest county, hoping to revive Alloa Co-op Bowling Club’s faded and warped sign in their centenary year. Meanwhile, Dom delivers Steve a 19th-century regulator clock from the Hebrides that has a ghostly connection, and Will heads north to Rothes to learn the fiery, and very loud, craft behind forging traditional copper stills for the multibillion-dollar whisky industry.

programme.title: The Town That Floored the World
programme.desc: How did the Scottish east coast port town of Kirkcaldy become the world centre for linoleum? The Town That Floored the World traces the history of that “magic material” to its origins in the mid 19th century, and tells how one town built its fortunes on its manufacture. Current and former linoleum workers, and Kirkcaldy bairns including crime writer Val McDermid, share their stories of a life in flooring. Lino’s role in high art and design is also traced. Narrated by John Sessions.

programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: In 2024, the body of 65-year-old groundsman Brian Low is discovered on a country track in rural Aberfeldy, his beloved black labrador Millie by his side. Police assume that Brian has suffered a medical episode, but six days later, the post-mortem reveals the shocking truth - Brian has been shot dead. His former colleague and gamekeeper on the estate where he worked, David Campbell, now stands trial for his murder. With the site of the murder exposed to the elements for days, police are unable to forensically link anyone to the deceased. The prosecution builds a case against the accused around smaller, individual strands of circumstantial evidence while working to convince the jury that he is guilty beyond reasonable doubt.

programme.title: The Fringe, Fame and Me
programme.desc: The story of how a small Scottish arts festival that began in 1947 became a national institution that has seen new stars forged, careers made and dreams dashed. Told by the stars who first found fame at the Edinburgh Fringe, this is the inside story of what it takes to make a name here - from those who enjoyed overnight success to those who slogged for years to make it. Through their triumphs, favourite jokes and sometimes painful failures, we discover a hidden history of British comedy, revealing how the gags we find funny and the comedians we love reflect our changing culture.

programme.title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim
programme.desc: Celebrity couple Julie Wilson Nimmo and Greg Hemphill share their passion for wild outdoor swimming in Scotland and give us an unprecedented insight into their lives as a married couple. This week, Jules and Greg are in Glasgow and Edinburgh, exploring Scotland’s urban cold-water locations.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the drought takes its toll on Longmeadow, Monty takes stock of his garden and has a radical rethink about what he should be growing in the future. With this in mind, he takes cuttings of some drought-resistant plants as a way of saving money. There is also a rambling rose in desperate need of a haircut and lots of produce to harvest in the veg garden, so as always, there is plenty to be getting on with. Frances Tophill visits the picturesque village of Clovelly in north Devon, where gardening on a clifftop is not without its challenges. And in Norfolk, Adam Frost explores a walled kitchen garden steeped in history but planted with a modern eye. On the Isle of Wight, a couple tell the incredible story of how they’ve reimagined the Victorian garden of the poet Alfred, Lord Tennyson, while a gardener in East Anglia showcases his love of naturalistic planting.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: George Anderson and Brian Cunningham delve into the mailbox to tackle a host of viewers’ questions sent in from around the country. Even though we are well into the growing season, the pair start a major new project as they launch a makeover of a Beechgrove area known as the Crooked Garden. One of the first parts of that revamp is the creation of a stumpery, a growing technique based on an old tree and planted with a range of ferns. George has details on how to feed a cherry tree, Brian is back in the 8x6 greenhouse, and there is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt serves up a delicious summer feast from some of your favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Ben Lippett dishes up his baked paprika cod with a chorizo and pea dressing, which pairs perfectly with his mustardy bean salad. Karan Gokani brings his iconic hoppers, served with a spicy, fragrant black pork curry. Georgina Hayden makes vine leaf cake centrepieces filled with spiced pork, tomatoes and rice, served with thick Greek yogurt and plenty of fresh herbs. Olia Hercules presents soft berry buns filled with the best of seasonal fruit. Carmen O’Neal gives afternoon tea a cocktail glow-up, and Laura Whitmore tucks into either her food heaven, seafood linguine, or her food hell, a blooming onion. Meanwhile, Rick Stein goes on a heather honey hunt in the Scottish Highlands, and the Hairy Bikers get a taste of the Corsican holy trinity.

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Wildlife broadcaster Liz Bonnin has travelled the world, but Clare on Ireland's west coast keeps calling her back. Its wild landscape and biodiversity captivated her as a teenager, and Anna is eager to explore. Liz introduces Anna to those preserving Ireland's food culture by growing heritage fruits and vegetables. In Burren National Park, Liz reflects on her initial lack of love for Irish food, but Anna takes her to an award-winning goat cheesemaker to change her mind.

programme.title: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook
programme.desc: With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family. In this episode she helps 52-year-old builder Tony Sartori, who has never cooked a meal in his life, to master a delicious Mediterranean-inspired menu which includes a grilled peach and burrata salad, crispy salmon with polenta chips and grilled asparagus, and a dessert with real wow factor.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
programme.desc: Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations, this episode he's turning his attention to texture. Success in the kitchen isn't just about tastes and flavours - contrasting textures can really lift a dish. He'll be making a classic savoury pie with a puff pastry crust, and will be putting traditional pizza ingredients together in a new way to make an entirely original dish. Nigel also travels to Brighton to meet a couple who have their own seafront smokery, who'll be showing him a soft and crisp recipe of their own.

programme.title: Wir in Bayern - Das Schönste aus 2025
programme.desc: Wir in Bayern - Das Schönste aus 2025 - Zu Gast bei "Wir in Bayern" ist der Priester Christoph Diehl. Alfred Fahr macht Polenta-Schnitten mit geschmorten Auberginen und Feigencreme, und Kaddi Kestler stellt wieder eine besondere Radltour vor. Außerdem zeigt "Wir in Bayern" einen Beitrag über "Rope Skipping", besucht die Handgraveurin Anna Frei und berichtet über den "Tag der Restauratoren". In den Sommerferien blickt "Wir in Bayern" zurück auf die schönsten Momente aus dem Jahr 2025. Es gibt ein Wiedersehen mit inspirierenden Gästen und spannenden Geschichten. Und mit den leckeren Rezepten zum Kochen und Backen sowie hilfreichen Servicetipps wird das Wiederentdecken Freude bereiten.

programme.title: Abendschau - Der Süden
programme.desc: Abendschau - Der Süden - Die Sendung berichtet von Montag bis Freitag über aktuelle Ereignisse, Menschen und Entwicklungen aus Bayern. Das Regionalmagazin greift Themen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur und Sport auf und zeigt, was die Menschen im Freistaat bewegt. Ob kommunale Herausforderungen, gesellschaftliche Debatten, besondere Freizeitangebote oder spannende Geschichten aus dem Alltag - die Sendung bietet einen vielfältigen Blick auf den Süden Bayerns. Mit Reportagen, Hintergrundberichten und Interviews informiert sie über regionale Themen und ihre Bedeutung vor Ort.

programme.title: Abendschau
programme.desc: Abendschau - Das bewegt Bayern heute - Seit 1954 informiert die "Abendschau" über Neuigkeiten und Wissenswertes aus dem Freistaat Bayern und zählt damit zu den ältesten Fernsehsendungen Deutschlands. Die regionalen Berichte werden häufig durch sorgfältig recherchiertes Hintergrundwissen ergänzt. Das Format umfasst zudem Beiträge zu Kultur und Musik. Gelegentlich führen die Moderatoren Gespräche mit Studiogästen zu aktuellen Themen. programme.title: Space Night
programme.desc: Space Night - Heute: How to become an Astronaut? Die Sendung nimmt die Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer mit auf eine faszinierende Reise durch das Universum. Eindrucksvolle Aufnahmen und wissenschaftlich fundierte Animationen machen ferne Galaxien, Sterne und kosmische Phänomene erlebbar. Grundlage sind die Erkenntnisse modernster Observatorien und Teleskope, die mit hochentwickelter Technik immer tiefere Einblicke in das Weltall ermöglichen. Die Sendung verbindet anschaulich die jahrtausendealte Faszination für die Astronomie mit den neuesten Ergebnissen der Weltraumforschung und lädt dazu ein, die unendlichen Weiten des Kosmos zu entdecken.

programme.title: Stationen
programme.desc: Michi Schreiber ist erfolgreiche Buchautorin und Affenforscherin. Die 29-Jährige hat ihren Abschluss als Primatologin an der renommierten Oxford Universität gemacht und sich ganz der Arbeit mit Affen in Südafrika verschrieben. Alles wirkt wie eine Bilderbuchgeschichte, bis Michi Schreiber bei einem schweren Autounfall 2025 ihr Gedächtnis verliert. Jetzt lebt sie wieder in der Eifel und kämpft dafür, nach Afrika zu ihren geliebten Affen zurückzukehren. Nur Wochen vor ihrem Unfall war Michi Schreiber kurz davor, in Südafrika eine Auffangstation für Affen zu gründen, die verletzt oder im illegalen Tierhandel beschlagnahmt wurden.

programme.desc: An ihrem 50. Geburtstag steht Katja die Tür zu einem neuen Leben offen: Ihr Sohn Aron wird ausziehen. Aron hat auch eine Schwester, Helena. Nun hat Katja für Aron einen Platz in einer Wohngemeinschaft für autistische Menschen bekommen - ihr persönlicher "Sechser im Lotto", denn es gibt nur wenige Plätze in Deutschland. Für Katja fühlt es sich an, als würde sie ein dreijähriges Kind weggeben. Aron hat fast all die Jahre in ihrem Bett geschlafen, weil ihn das beruhigt hat. programme.title: Inseln Italiens: Liparische Inseln

Süßwasser wurde hier früher noch in Zisternen gesammelt, bis Anfang der 90er-Jahre schließlich auch die kleine Insel Alicudi vom Wasserschiff versorgt werden konnte. Doch bis heute sind bei Sturm, wenn kein Schiff im Hafen ankern kann, die Inseln von der Außenwelt abgeschnitten. Doch nicht nur das ...

programme.title: Am Gardasee

programme.title: Fußball: 3. Liga

programme.title: Ländermagazin

Platz an seinen Riesling - völlig überraschend! Grund genug für Alexandra Rinschler, diesen Spitzenwein und seinen Macher aus Mittelfranken einmal unter die Lupe zu nehmen.

programme.title: Das andere Spanien - Im Reich der Vögel
programme.desc: Das andere Spanien - Im Reich der Vögel - Von diesem Landstrich haben viele noch nie gehört: die Extremadura. Doch eine Entdeckungsreise in diese entlegene Region Spaniens an der Grenze zu Portugal offenbart eine ungeahnte Artenvielfalt. In einem der am dünnsten besiedelten Landstriche in ganz Europa hat sich seit Jahrhunderten eine nahezu intakte Umwelt erhalten. In den endlosen Weiten der spanischen Extremadura an der Grenze Spaniens zu Portugal stehen noch heute uralte, knorrige Eichen auf ausgedehnten, naturbelassenen Weidegründen. Bekannt ist die Region allenfalls für sein wichtigstes Exportgut: den Iberischen Schinken. Aber die Extremadura hält nicht nur die perfekten Lebensbedingungen für die Iberischen Schweine bereit. ...

programme.title: Auf der Unteren Lärchenbergalm
programme.desc: Auf der Unteren Lärchenbergalm - Josef Kahn ist ein Bergbauer im Austrag, auf der Unteren Lärchenbergalm in den Kitzbüheler Alpen versorgt er 30 Stück Rindvieh, Ziegen und Schweine, die Katze sorgt für sich selber. Seit 20 Jahren freut er sich auf jeden Almsommer in der Bergeinsamkeit. Hier oben ist sein Reich, alles auf der Unteren Lärchenbergalm ist beseelt von seinem Wesen. Der Sepp ist wohl ein Bauer, aber ein Bauer mit einem starken Sinn für Poesie, für die Poesie, die sich in den einfachen elementaren Dingen verbirgt, die den Sepp auf der kleinen Alm umgeben. Sepp arbeitet den ganzen Tag, er verarbeitet die Milch der zehn Kühe zu Butter und Käse. Er verrichtet seine Arbeiten mit eleganten und klar gesetzten ...

programme.title: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel
programme.desc: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel - Heute: Auto-Archäologie: "Bavarian Pickers" retten Isetta Die Sendung nimmt sich Zeit für besondere Geschichten aus den Regionen Bayerns und lädt dazu ein, genauer hinzuschauen und Neues zu entdecken. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Menschen, die mit Engagement, Kreativität und Leidenschaft ihre Heimat prägen und bewahren. Reportagen und Porträts vermitteln Einblicke in Geschichte und Gegenwart, in Traditionen, Handwerk, Kultur und Natur. Dabei erzählt die Sendung von einem lebendigen und verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Heimat und zeigt, wie vielfältig das Leben zwischen Spessart und Karwendel ist. Authentische Begegnungen und eindrucksvolle Landschaften machen jede Ausgabe zu einer ...

programme.title: BR24
programme.desc: BR24 - Aus der BR24-Redaktion kommt täglich eine 15-minütige BR24-Sendung um 16.00 Uhr und die halbstündige Hauptausgabe mit Sportblock um 18.30 Uhr sowie eine Ausgabe um 21.45 Uhr. An Sonntagen und Feiertagen ist auch die Hauptausgabe 15 Minuten lang, die Spätausgabe beginnt am Sonntag in der Regel erst um 23.00 Uhr. Montags bis freitags wird ferner zwischen 8.00 bis 15.00 Uhr fünf Ausgaben der BR24-100-Sekunden-News gesendet. Darüber hinaus bietet BR24 ein strukturiertes Nachrichtenprogramm mit festen Ressorts wie Bayern, Kultur, Wirtschaft und Sport.

programme.title: Im Zeitalter des Feuers - Asche und Wiedergeburt in Spaniens Wäldern
programme.desc: Waldbrände gehören zum natürlichen Rhythmus der Erneuerung. Die andalusischen Korkeichenwälder beispielsweise trotzen seit Jahrtausenden den immer wiederkehrenden Feuersbrünsten. Ihre mehrere Zentimeter dicke Korkborke schützt die Bäume und die darunter liegenden Knospen vor den Flammen. Einige dort lebende Arten brauchen die Brände sogar, um zu überleben. Nach jedem Feuer werden die Karten im Waldsystem gemischt.

programme.title: Kunst + Krempel
programme.desc: Kunst & Krempel - Heute: Familienschätze entdecken in der Musikhalle Ludwigsburg Familienschätze, Dachbodenfunde, Flohmarktschnäppchen: Was die Gäste den Expertinnen und Experten bei "Kunst + Krempel" auf den Tisch legen, sorgt immer wieder für große Überraschungen - und lässt in den Beratungen Kunstgeschichte lebendig werden. Zwei Blech-Lkw aus den 1950er-Jahren sind in tadellosem Zustand und begeistern das Expertenteam von "Kunst + Krempel" in der Musikhalle Ludwigsburg. Außerdem werden begutachtet: ein Gemälde aus dem 19. Jahrhundert, eine kostbare Taschenuhr und eine Jugendstil-Silberschale.

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: Tagesschau - Seit 1952 wird die Nachrichtensendung präsentiert. Sie informiert täglich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen. Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein. Neben den aktuellen Nachrichten werden Hintergründe, Zusammenhänge und Einordnungen vermittelt, die das Geschehen in einen größeren Kontext setzen. Dabei steht eine präzise, sachliche und unabhängige Berichterstattung im Mittelpunkt.

programme.title: Die drei Musketiere
programme.desc: Der Bauernsohn D'Artagnan kommt 1625 aus der Provinz nach Paris, um sich den tapferen Kämpfern im Dienst des Königs anzuschließen, den sogenannten Musketieren. Schon bald gerät er in Konflikt mit Rochefort, der für Kardinal Richelieu die schmutzigen Geschäfte erledigt. Er lernt die stolzen und mutigen Musketiere Athos, Aramis und Porthos kennen, die bereit sind, ihn in ihren Kreis aufzunehmen.

programme.title: Die vier Musketiere
programme.desc: Mit Unterstützung des englischen Lord Buckingham plant eine Gruppe von Protestanten den Aufstand gegen König Ludwig XIII. Die Gegenwehr des Königs wird durch die Intrigen von Kardinal Richelieu und dessen Gehilfen Rochefort und Lady de Winter erheblich geschwächt. D'Artagnan durchschaut das falsche Spiel der Lady und rettet mithilfe der Musketiere Athos, Aramis und Porthos den König.

programme.title: Die schwarze Tulpe
programme.desc: Frankreich, 1789: Der junge Edelmann Julien de Saint Preux sieht seinem Bruder Guillaume täuschend ähnlich. Guillaume führt ein Doppelleben, als maskierter Wegelagerer überfällt er seine Standesgenossen und plündert sie aus. Als dieser in Gefahr gerät, als Bandit gehängt zu werden, schlüpft Julien in seine Rolle und kämpft am Vorabend der Französischen Revolution für die Rechte des Volkes.

programme.title: Der talentierte Mr. Ripley

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc: Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy. We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations. One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Policy push brings smart homes into everyday life
programme.desc: China has expanded and upgraded its dual-new policy package, marking the first-ever inclusion of smart home products in central government consumption subsidies. CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores the Beijing Premium Housing Tech Expo, testing out smart home systems with voice control and automatic sensory adjustment. She also visits offline Suning stores, speaking with outlet managers and customers to uncover how smart home solutions are gaining mainstream traction, entering ordinary households, and driving the upgrade of China’s manufacturing industry.

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap
programme.desc: As CXMT makes its market debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, the listing is drawing attention far beyond the trading floor. As China's top DRAM producer, CXMT sits at the center of the country's push to strengthen its semiconductor capabilities and build a more resilient technology ecosystem. What does the IPO mean for investors, the capital market, and the future of the global memory-chip industry? Join us on BizTalk as we explore market forces, policy priorities and the roadmap to technology self-reliance behind the landmark listing.

programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services. At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the cutting edge of Chinese industry. We visit China’s first offshore spaceport to see rockets launch toward the stars and move to Hangzhou’s E-Fashion Town, where AI turns designs into reality in seconds. We also follow the "fantastic journey" of a bag of garbage as it transforms into energy and bricks with the help of industrial intelligence. Finally, we explore the "emotional economy," where young people find solace in trendy toys and historical fragrances.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Why China's theme parks are having a moment
programme.desc: Looking for a cool summer escape with a twist? China’s theme parks are more than rides—they’re immersive worlds of blockbuster stories, spectacular shows, high-tech thrills, and local flavors. Earlier this year, CGTN's Lincoln Humphries and Yu Hongyu explored two of China's best-known parks to see why they’re drawing crowds from across the country. From unforgettable live performances to next-level interactive experiences, discover a fresh way to travel in China.

programme.title: Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?

programme.title: So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine richtige Familie – Teil 1

programme.title: Cheers: Eine richtige Familie – Teil 2

programme.title: Cheers: Der unwiderstehliche Frasier

programme.title: Cheers: Maler im Haus
programme.desc: Norm hat Schulden im Cheers. Um sie abzuzahlen, streicht er Rebeccas Büro. Dabei lernt er sie näher kennen. Er begreift, dass hinter ihrer rauhen Schale ein weicher Kern steckt. Das freundliche Verhältnis zwischen ihnen bleibt auch Sam nicht verborgen.

programme.title: Cheers: Spitzname und andere Frivolitäten
programme.desc: Die Cheers-Truppe hat durch einen Kollegen von Frasier Informationen über Rebecca erhalten: Rebeccas Spitznamen zu ihrer Studienzeit waren ,,Partyhase Nummer eins" und ,,Backseat-Becky".

programme.title: Cheers: Die Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith verbringen einen romantischen Abend miteinander. Tollpatsch Frasier bringt es jedoch fertig, die Stimmung zu zerstören: Er erklärt seiner Gattin in spe, dass er einen Ehevertrag aufsetzen wolle. Wütend verlässt Lilith das Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody hegt schon seit langem den Wunsch, Schauspieler zu werden. Er spricht oft vor, wird aber abgelehnt. Da verspricht ihm der Regisseur, dass er im Falle eines Ausfalls einspringen könnte.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Alibimann
programme.desc: Rebecca hat ein Problem: Ihr Chef Drake, den sie heimlich anhimmelt, hält sie für eine Lesbe. Um ihn vom Gegenteil zu überzeugen, muss sie in männlicher Begleitung zu Drakes Party erscheinen. Sam bietet sich unverbindlich an.

programme.title: Cheers: Professor Clavin
programme.desc: Cliff hat sich verliebt. Seine Angebetete Sally ist eine graue Maus. Cliff würde jedoch gerne mit seiner neuen Freundin angeben. So verwandelt sie sich unter seiner Anleitung zu einer schönen Frau. Nun interessieren sich auf einmal etliche Männer für sie.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam als Weihnachtsmann
programme.desc: Die Mitarbeiter vom Cheers sind sauer auf Rebecca. Sie hat alle für den Heiligabend zum Dienst eingeteilt. Dennoch haben alle, außer Sam, ein Weihnachtsgeschenk für die strenge Chefin besorgt. Nun versucht Sam, schleunigst ein Präsent aufzutreiben.

programme.title: Cheers: Affentheater
programme.desc: Norman und Cliff haben sich böse verkracht. Es scheint, als würden sie nicht mehr zueinander finden. Rebecca vermietet das Hinterzimmer an einen Buchclub. Es stört sie nicht, dass sie den Männern damit ihren gewohnten Billardabend streitig macht.

programme.title: Cheers: Scherben bringen Glück
programme.desc: Rebecca richtet eine Cocktailparty für ihren Chef aus. Sam und Woody beschwatzen sie so lange, bis Rebecca die beiden als Barkeeper anheuert. Bei der Party geht eine kostbare Vase zu Bruch.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg der Kneipen – Teil 1
programme.desc: Der Tag des Sieges jährt sich zum zweiten Mal. In einem langjährigen Wettkampf mit Gary, dem Betreiber der Konkurrenzbar, haben es Sam und seine Leute ausnahmsweise mal geschafft: Nach 137 Wettkämpfen haben sie beim Bowling gesiegt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Kuss-Wette
programme.desc: Sam und Woody wetten, wer von ihnen Rebecca zuerst einen Kuss geben wird. Sehr zum Vergnügen aller anderen im Cheers. Denn die steigen in die Wette ein und setzen hohe Beträge auf ihren Favoriten. Sam und Woody geben alles, um das Rennen zu machen.

programme.title: Cheers: Pech für Rebecca
programme.desc: Rebecca erfährt, dass ihr Chef Evan Drake nach Japan auswandern will. Seit Jahren ist sie schon in ihn verliebt. Nun will Rebecca ihm vor seiner Abreise ihre Liebe offenbaren. Dabei schreckt sie auch vor den ausgefallensten Ideen nicht zurück.

programme.title: Cheers: Geschäft ist Geschäft
programme.desc: Greg Stone, der neue Besitzer des Cheers, stattet der Bar einen Besuch ab. Die ehrgeizige Rebecca gibt alles, um einen guten Eindruck zu machen. Sie erleidet jedoch eine Bruchladung: Stone kündigt Rebecca und befördert Sam zum Geschäftsführer des Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam ist nur knapp einer Vaterschaftsklage entronnen. Deshalb schwört er in einem schwachen Moment bei Gott, dass er drei Monate enthaltsam leben werde. Ein Versprechen, das schwer einzuhalten ist: Die Sünde in Form schöner Frauen lauert auf Sam.

programme.title: Cheers: Kleine Kompromisse
programme.desc: Rebecca will Martin Teal, den neuen Besitzer des Cheers, treffen. Da wird sie von einem Jugendlichen belästigt. Sie behandelt ihn herablassend. Es stellt sich heraus, dass er der neue Chef ist. Trotz der Abfuhr macht Martin sich erneut an Rebecca heran.

programme.title: Cheers: Viva Mexiko!
programme.desc: Rebecca will auf keinen Fall Martin Teal, den Chef vom Cheers, heiraten. So hält sie weiterhin an der Notlüge fest, sie sei mit Sam liiert. Sam lässt sich darauf ein, weil er hofft, Rebecca endlich ins Bett zu bekommen.

programme.title: Cheers: Vorsicht, Glatteis!
programme.desc: Carla ist überglücklich: Ihr Mann Eddie kehrt nach Monaten von seiner Eisrevue-Tournee zurück. Ihre Freude erhält bald einen herben Dämpfer: Eddie schwärmt ständig von seiner Kollegin Franzi.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Schwulen-Schwindel
programme.desc: Norm hat einen kleinen Nebenjob. Er streicht die Wohnung eines Psychologen-Ehepaars. Währenddessen versucht ein Innendesigner, die Wohnung eleganter zu gestalten. Da ihm das nicht gelingt, stellt Norm die Möbel um. Das Ehepaar ist davon ganz hingerissen.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it’s Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting… Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it’s all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: The Art of Governance: How China revitalizes its cultural heritage
programme.desc: Around the world, ancient crafts are fading. In Italy, master artisans compare themselves to endan-gered species – rare, protected, and struggling to survive. But in China, a different story is unfold-ing. A new generation is breathing life into centuries-old traditions – not as museum pieces, but as living, evolving art. This is The Art of Governance: how China's youth are turning heritage into a bridge between past and future, and between cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: Beijing Trough Art
programme.desc: When it comes to Beijing’s art, you may picture the Forbidden City and ancient porcelain pieces. In fact, Beijing hosts numerous outstanding modern‑art museums, whose buildings are works of art in their own right. Especially in pivotal period,

programme.title: The Art of Governance: How China revitalizes its cultural heritage

This is The Art of Governance: how China's youth are turning heritage into a bridge between past and future, and between cultures.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.
